sections.overview: This Neotropical fruit bat occurs in Bolivia, southeastern Brazil, Paraguay and northern Argentina.
sections.identification: The species is a member of the leaf-nosed bat family Phyllostomidae; detailed distinguishing features were not described in the sources used here.
sections.habitat: Records include the Atlantic Forest and coastal shrubland in Brazil.
sections.diet: It eats fruit, including soft, pulpy fruit; flower visits have also been recorded.
sections.behavior: Some Paraná records suggest seasonal presence, but migration patterns remain poorly known.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific reproductive information was not available in the consulted accounts.
sections.ecology: As a fruit eater, it may disperse seeds; pollen has also been found on bats visiting a recorded flower species.
sections.conservation: The Mammal Diversity Database lists it as Least Concern globally.
